hypothesis: AMD prebuilt llama.cpp b8407 (ROCm/HIP backend for gfx1151) can load and serve Qwen3.5-9B-Q6_K.gguf with full GPU offload on the GTR Pro / Radeon 8060S hardware.
protocol_before_run: Verify GGUF integrity via sha256 (LAB03-qwen35-9b). Verify hardware passport from LAB02-after-rocm. Set LD_LIBRARY_PATH to the unpacked binary directory to pick up the self-contained ROCm/HIP libraries. Launch llama-server on 127.0.0.1:8089 with -ngl 99 -c 4096 -fa on, wait for health, send one chat completion, then run llama-bench with 3 repetitions at pp2048 depth4096 and tg128 depth4096. Stop the server, snapshot /sys/class/drm/card1/device/mem_info_*, save logs and binaries.sha256.

hardware_snapshot.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 w/ Radeon 8060S

planned_attempts.purpose: smoke: confirm ROCm 7.2 stack from rocm-preflight-01 can drive an actual LLM on this hardware

unavailable.vulkan_pair: AMD prebuilt b8407 archive ships HIP-only; a paired Vulkan build from the same upstream commit is not produced here. Full paired comparison is the responsibility of LAB04.
unavailable.flash_attn_active: b8407 reports flash_attn=false in JSON even with -fa on flag — known b8407 quirk; not measured in this smoke
unavailable.tool_calling: Not exercised in this smoke; would need a separate test for round-trip integrity.

conclusion: AMD prebuilt llama.cpp b8407 (ROCm/HIP) successfully runs Qwen3.5-9B-Q6_K on GTR Pro / gfx1151 with full GPU offload (n_gpu_layers=99, projected 7136 MiB device, 110774 MiB free for KV). Chat completion works (Qwen3.5-9B answers 'Paris' to capital-of-France with 226 t/s pp, 27.8 t/s tg). llama-bench at depth=4096: pp2048 = 744.5 t/s (median of 3), tg128 = 25.7 t/s. fits comfortably in GTT (7.46 GiB << 100 GiB cap) and far from the Vulkan heap1 budget limit (65.99 GiB). Qwen3.5 hybrid attention+SSM and the no-VMM b8407 build are the most likely causes of tg staying around 26 t/s; flash_attn=false in the JSON further indicates b8407 is not the fastest path for this architecture. This is a runtime smoke, not the full LAB04 paired Vulkan/HIP comparison.
